issueSummary: The current Wix homepage has real local service information, but generic hero copy, template artifacts, and misleading booking prices weaken trust before visitors request a quote.
topFindings: Hero does not quickly state the service mix, Dodge City area, or quote CTA.
Booking-widget prices such as $2/$8 for project work look like placeholders and damage credibility.
Trust signals and next-step quote flow are buried or vague.
preservedDesign: Kept the simple Wix-style nav, large outdoor green/lime hero feel, about/services/contact rhythm, Arial typography, and service-card structure while removing trust-damaging template artifacts.
criticalCoverageStatus: All critical findings were fixed or materially improved in the prototype: specific hero/CTA, quote-based services instead of placeholder prices, and cleaned-up template/contact/footer elements.
